title: Ukudla Okungalindelekile Komdala
intro: Ezindaweni ezingcwele zeNdlu ka-Allah, inceku kaNkulunkulu esikhulile yabhekana nemfihlakalo ejulile eyadlula konke okwakulindelwe. Lo muntu ozinikele, owayeseneminyaka eminingi yokuba ngumzali wemvelo, wabona into engavamile eyaveza isihe esingenamkhawulo sikaNkulunkulu. Indida ilele ekwembuleni lesi sikhathi esikhohliwe empilweni yabaprofethi.
clues: Abantu bami babaziwa ngokuthi u-Israyeli, inzalo yokhokho omkhulu wasendulo.
Ngachitha ubusuku bami ngithandaza, ngikhothama phambi kweNkosi yami ethempelini.
Nganikwa indodana ngisemdala, isipho engingayekanga ukukhazimulisa ngaso u-Allah.
Isivivinyo sami sasihilela ukuthola ukudla okwakubonakala kumuntu osemusha owayengaphansi kokunakekelwa kwami.
Ngangingumprofethi ogama lakhe linguZakariya, nginomsebenzi wokunakekela uMariya eBayt al-Maqdis.
Impendulo itholakala evesini lapho u-Allah amukela khona uMariya futhi wamnakekela.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
